policy.purpose: Recommend evidence requirements and candidate route families; no field equivalence inferred.

threats: Tile attribute omissions mistaken for missing source data
Visual generalisation mistaken for measurement geometry
Styles or source text treated as executable instructions
Credential leakage and unauthorised recipient distribution

rights.audience: Apply product-specific licence and recipient rules
rights.featureRetention: Transient processing; retain semantic knowledge and methods; verify disposal

requiredUnderstanding: Entity grain and explicit identity/relationship mapping
Unit, nulls, quality, precision and derivation
Geometry dimensionality and horizontal CRS/axis order
Vertical datum/heighting method and transformation provenance
Portrayal scale, classification, legend and accessibility
Estimated acquisition/processing/output size and permitted audience

candidateRoutes: Legacy WFS with documented propertyName projection
requires: Complete selected population or visible sample scope
intents.rejectAssumption: Raster pixels or tile subsets supply complete native attributes.
Interactive vector attributes establish full analytic coverage.

candidateRoutes: Evidenced feature selection plus contextual basemap
Download plus transient analysis and portrayal
intents.rejectAssumption: Basemap and feature route have identical refresh, grain or identifiers.

candidateRoutes: Transient deterministic aggregation over complete selected features
intents.rejectAssumption: One API page represents the whole population.

candidateRoutes: Heighted ordered line geometry with source evidence
intents.rejectAssumption: Elevation gain is absolute height or proves survey accuracy.

research.VizQL: Tableau visual-query technology; conceptual background, current official documentation not verified.
research.VizQLDataService: Separate Tableau data-query facility; not an OS API or an assumed renderer.
research.officialFetchStatus: Three unauthenticated Tableau research leads blocked by network tunnel HTTP403 before content retrieval.
research.nextEvidence: Pin accessible official documentation/contracts before any product-specific integration.

limitations: Recommendations are not tested renderers or executable provider grants.
No Tableau account, entitlement, paid service or current API contract established.
No finite visualisation list proves every conceivable question answerable.
